items: The platform for organising and enjoying competitive and casual Pokémon TCG, VGC and Pokémon GO events.
Do I need a Player ID?
Yes. Official tournaments require a valid Play! Pokémon Player ID.
For TCG, bring a legal deck and game accessories; for VGC or GO, bring a charged, updated device with your team registered.

refund.title: Terms and refund policy
refund.notice: NOTICE: By purchasing a ticket, you accept these terms as a binding contract.
sections: As this leisure event has a fixed date and capacity, purchases are final under Article 103.l of Spanish Royal Legislative Decree 1/2007. Personal circumstances do not qualify for refunds.
Unexpected circumstances affecting an attendee do not override the no-refund clause because infrastructure is booked according to ticket sales.
You may transfer a ticket by emailing us from the original address at least 72 hours in advance with the new holder's full details. A €5 fee may apply.
If the organiser permanently cancels the event, the face value will be refunded. Date changes provide a 14-day refund request period.
Purchase implies acceptance of venue and Play! Pokémon rules. Violent or unsporting conduct may result in removal without a refund.
